literal: Having investigated, without showing partiality, having adhered to justice, towards anyone having deliberated, that which is done indeed is proper rule.
translation: To investigate thoroughly, to show no partiality, to adhere to justice, and to act after careful deliberation towards anyone—this indeed is proper rule.
modern: எதனையும் நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து, யாரிடமும் பாரபட்சம் காட்டாமல், நடுவுநிலைமையோடு பொருந்தி, அனைவரிடமும் தகுந்ததை ஆராய்ந்து செய்வதே சரியான ஆட்சியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essence of a just rule. The ruler must first investigate any matter thoroughly and act without showing personal favoritism. By adhering strictly to justice and carefully deliberating the consequences for anyone involved, the actions taken constitute true and proper governance. The word 'iṟai' has multiple meanings including king or god, but here it specifically means impartial justice, which is the core duty of sovereignty.
